title: GPT-5.5: Official OpenAI Prompting Guidance
summary: The official technical manual for GPT-5.5, OpenAI's flagship multimodal model released in April 2026. It outlines the 'Outcome-First' prompting paradigm, prioritizing the definition of success criteria over step-by-step instructions.
research_notes: Achieved a record 82.7% on Terminal-Bench 2.0; the guide emphasizes prompt compression and the removal of 'process noise' for optimal performance.

evolution.summary: Transitioned to the default ChatGPT model on May 5, 2026, replacing the GPT-5.3 series. It is the first fully retrained base model since GPT-4.5, featuring native omnimodality and deep Codex integration.
